distribution: Generated front outline and six picking masks only. No player 3D shapes or original skin atlas.

processing.pose: Inspection A-pose: UpperArmR X=8; UpperArmL X=-8; UpperFootR X=3; UpperFootL X=-3; body rotations otherwise zero; small facial rotations retained
processing.omitted: Hair, clothing, held items and disabled faces
processing.renderer: Independent SVG projection of native cuboids and UVs; Chrome SVG rasterization; not an in-game screenshot
processing.regionSplits: Coarse UI groups: Head+Neck; UpperTorso+LowerTorso; each UpperArm+LowerArm; each UpperFoot+LowerFoot. These six UI groups correspond to supported parent body regions; runtime colors and hover details use server snapshots.

neutralOutline.regionDividers: Inner rings of 6 occlusion-resolved visible region unions; no per-face subdivisions
neutralOutline.interior: flat neutral; outline-white variant has transparent region interiors
